intro: Housing is a topic everyone living in Poland meets: looking for a flat, talking to a landlord, complaining about a fault. Especially useful: the «Rozmowa» about renting and a formal letter of complaint.
speaking.0.promptUa: Describe the illustration. Say where these people are, what they are doing and how they feel. Also say what you think will happen next.
speaking.0.phrases.0.ua: In the illustration I can see a flat to rent.
speaking.0.tips.0: Rental vocabulary is half the answer: **czynsz, kaucja, umowa, meble**. Use it in your prediction («zapytają o…»).
speaking.0.tips.1: **Para** — «couple»; **para młoda** — the bride and groom! Be precise: «młoda para» (a young couple).
speaking.0.tips.2: A prediction at the end is a mandatory point: «Moim zdaniem… wkrótce…».
speaking.1.promptUa: Describe the flat you would like to live in. Say where it is, what it looks like and why it would be ideal for you.
speaking.1.phrases.0.ua: My dream flat would be located…
speaking.1.phrases.1.ua: I would like it to have…
speaking.1.tips.0: **Tryb warunkowy** (znajdowałoby się, byłoby, mogłabym) — natural for a «dream» and instantly gives you «zakres środków».
speaking.1.tips.1: Structure: **where → how many rooms → what matters most → why ideal → where I live now**.
speaking.1.tips.2: **Uda mi się** («I will succeed») — a useful impersonal construction.
speaking.2.promptUa: You are phoning the owner of a flat to rent. Find out the details and conditions and arrange a viewing.
speaking.2.phrases.1.ua: Are electricity charges included in the rent?
speaking.2.phrases.2.ua: Do I have to pay a deposit?
speaking.2.tips.0: **Media** — utilities (prąd, woda, gaz, internet). Always ask what is included in the czynsz.
speaking.2.tips.1: **Kaucja** is returned when you move out — don't confuse it with «czynsz» (the rent).
speaking.2.tips.2: «Jeśli mi się spodoba, chętnie podpiszę» — a careful agreement without commitment, very useful in real life.
writing.0.promptUa: You have moved into a new flat. Write a text message to friends: invite them to a housewarming on Saturday, give the address and time and ask them to say whether they'll come.
writing.0.phrases.0.ua: I invite you to a housewarming!
writing.0.phrases.1.ua: There will be pizza and lots of good music.
writing.0.phrases.2.ua: Let me know whether you'll come.
writing.0.tips.0: **Parapetówka** — a housewarming; the exam likes this word in exactly this kind of text message.
writing.0.tips.1: **Zapraszam Was** — in letters «Was/Wam/Wasz» addressed to several people are capitalised.
writing.1.promptUa: You have rented a flat for three months. The heating hasn't worked for a week and it's very cold. Write to the owner: describe the problem, explain what you have already done and ask for a quick repair.
writing.1.phrases.0.ua: I'm writing about the heating failure.
writing.1.phrases.1.ua: Unfortunately the problem is still there.
writing.1.phrases.2.ua: I kindly ask for the fastest possible repair.
writing.1.phrases.3.ua: I would be grateful if a technician could come…
writing.1.tips.0: Structure a complaint as **facts → what has already been done → what you expect** — polite but specific.
writing.1.tips.1: **Byłabym wdzięczna, gdyby…** — the conditional makes a request respectful.
writing.1.tips.2: Give deadlines («w ciągu trzech dni»): without a deadline the letter is just a complaint, not a request.
listening.0.intro: Listen to the announcement in the stairwell and answer the questions.
grammar.0.intro: Prepositions, degrees of comparison and tense forms in the topic «housing».
grammar.0.questions.0.why: Floor: **na piętrze** («on the floor»): «na trzecim piętrze».
grammar.0.questions.4.why: A future action after «kiedy» → future perfective: «kiedy się przeprowadzimy».
